game_identity_and_current_behavior.core_player_goal: drag hazards away before lingering bugs deplete health
game_identity_and_current_behavior.core_verb: press, drag, and release to clear
game_identity_and_current_behavior.fail_state: health reaches zero after pests remain active too long
game_identity_and_current_behavior.success_score_state: each successful removal grants score and partial health recovery
moment_to_moment_loop: bugs spawn on the central playfield
player drags the target away from its origin
successful long drag clears the target
uncleared bugs age into damaging hazards
difficulty increases and spawn cadence accelerates
game_identity_and_current_behavior.existing_progression: endless escalating survival pressure without explicit levels

input_control_mechanic.description: tap/click a bug, drag it, and release it

movement_mechanic.description: bugs idle in place with visual animation; dragged bugs follow pointer position

spawning_timing_mechanic.description: bugs spawn on a timer that shortens as difficulty rises

collision_contact_mechanic.description: pointer selects a bug within a radius; bug clears if drag distance exceeds threshold

scoring_progress_mechanic.description: score rises by fixed increments on clear; health also recovers on clear

hazard_mechanic.description: bugs become damaging after lingering long enough and drain health continuously

reward_collectible_mechanic.description: successful clear acts as the reward event with score, recovery, particles, and reactions

level_round_state_mechanic.description: start screen, active run, game over, plus endless escalation

ui_hud_feedback_mechanic.description: health bar, score text, reactions, and menu cards communicate status

audio_visual_feedback_mechanic.description: particles, overlays, warning flashes, and existing audio hooks provide feedback

complexity_profile.assessment: simple one-screen arcade with timing pressure and multitarget prioritization
what_more_complex_should_mean: safe pressure scaling through existing spawn/difficulty behavior
world evolution without input or scoring rewrites
fake_complexity_to_avoid: control changes that replace drag semantics

safe_theming_surfaces: visual identity of bugs and playfield

remix_premise.summary: The player is a young wizard defending Hogwarts by banishing cursed magical pests from increasingly important school spaces before protective wards collapse.
remix_premise.recognizability: Harry Potter-inspired through Hogwarts spaces, wand motions, magical wards, potion-room/library/owlery/battlement motifs, and whimsical-but-dangerous infestation framing.
remix_premise.compatibility_with_source_mechanics: The existing drag gesture cleanly maps to wand-guided banishing, while lingering pests naturally map to ward damage.

level_1.title: First-Year Corridor Sweep
level_1.definition: Base experience: banish obvious cursed beetles from a calm Hogwarts corridor while learning that quick wand-drags protect ward integrity.

level_1_5.title: Potion Spill Escalation
level_1_5.definition: Same mechanics, but stronger urgency and clearer magical contamination cues prove the world can escalate through presentation and pressure without changing the loop.

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: First-Year Corridor Sweep
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Keep the corridor wards stable by banishing obvious pests fast.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Introduce the base drag-clear loop with maximum readability.
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Cursed beetles threaten corridor charms; each banish restores ward calm.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: do not overdecorate the first level

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Potions Classroom Spill
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Contain a magical spill by banishing faster, more erratic-looking pests.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: First meaningful escalation in urgency and contamination feel.
safe_mechanics_knobs: slightly faster apparent pressure via presentation alignment with source ramp
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Potion-fumed scarabs spread instability; banishes reseal the spill zone.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: avoid murky low-contrast greens that hide bugs
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: glowing potion chamber with bubbling ambient motion

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Restricted Library Aisles
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Protect forbidden stacks from enchanted booklice swarms.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Present the full intended identity stack with denser thematic pressure.
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Library pests corrupt protective sigils; each banish stabilizes the archive.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: avoid book props overlapping touch targets
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: animated shelves and floating parchment dust

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Owlery Storm Watch
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Hold the tower wards together as wind and mail-chaos intensify.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Same core stack under stronger pressure and atmosphere.
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Storm-spooked pests spread through owl-post perches; banishes re-stabilize tower wards.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: wind effects must stay behind gameplay objects
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: moonlit storm tower with sweeping clouds and feathers

five_level_difficulty_progression.title: Astronomy Tower Midnight Defense
five_level_difficulty_progression.player_facing_goal: Survive the highest readable pressure and protect the final castle ward ring.
five_level_difficulty_progression.difficulty_intent: Near upper readable limit without sacrificing control safety.
safe_mechanics_knobs: most dramatic but still clear warning feedback
five_level_difficulty_progression.hazard_reward_interpretation: Elite cursed pests breach the final ward circle; every banish buys precious stability.
five_level_difficulty_progression.failure_risk_to_watch: do not let late-stage glow or particles reduce readability
five_level_difficulty_progression.visual_progression_beat: starry battlement climax with luminous ward circles

procedural_art_system.icon_style: bold readable magical glyph icons with thick outlines and glow accents
animation_principles: low-health intensification through pulse and color
implementation_preference: CSS overlays for HUD and screen cards
SVG-like sigil composition recreated with canvas paths
procedural_art_system.safe_fallback_if_external_assets_fail: Use fully procedural wizarding motifs and typography styling without depending on remote images or audio.

stage_1_must_preserve_and_execute: retitle and reframe the game into a wizarding pest-banishing fantasy
map HUD and reactions to ward/banish terminology
convert pointer affordance toward a wand-guided gesture look
leave input, scoring, and fail logic unchanged
stage_2_must_draw_build: build a recognizable Hogwarts-inspired world layer system
draw procedural magical pests and wizard-school props
improve readability without obscuring touch targets
stage_3_must_refine: polish copy, HUD clarity, particles, and motion graphics
integrate approved remote audio only if safe and catalog-compliant
tighten thematic continuity across all five worlds
stage_4_must_verify_and_repair: verify the five-level plan is readable and coherent
remove any flourish that reduces clarity or control reliability
